task: Browse the latest negative reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime for the game that won the 2023 VR Game of the Year Award.
agent_final_answer:
Game: Labyrinthine (by Valko Game Studios) - winner of the 2023 Steam Awards "VR Game of the Year" Award (confirmed via the Steam Awards 2023 page and the "Winner - VR Game of the Year" badge on the game's store page).

Method: On Labyrinthine's Steam store page, in "Customer reviews" I set Review Type = Negative, Display = Most Recent, and dragged the Playtime slider to its maximum minimum value "Over 95 hours". (Steam's playtime slider scale caps just below 100 hours - its numeric range tops out at ~95-96 hours before "No maximum", so an exact ">100" cannot be typed; "Over 95 hours" is the highest setting and still includes every reviewer who had 100+ hours at review time.) Every review below has well over 100 hours.

Latest NEGATIVE reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime (newest first):

1. "Hui" (display name in CJK) - 455.3 hrs on record (424.3 hrs at review time) - Posted Aug 14, 2025
   Repeatedly loses cosmetics and progress: Easter cosmetics vanished at the summer event, a hot-dog hat went missing, Halloween cosmetics collected ~1 AM Oct 21 disappeared, and on Dec 3 the character level dropped from over 400 to 284 with all cosmetics reverting to an earlier state. Says it only happens to them despite earning the items with friends; wants it fixed.

2. "xlazyfox" - 252.6 hrs on record (246.8 hrs at review time) - Posted Jul 23, 2025
   Enjoyed story mode but everything after was "a slug". An avid collector, frustrated that after almost 250 hours they still don't have half the cosmetics. Asks for a way to guarantee/buy rare cosmetics and reduce duplicate rolls (rolled the visor and granny glasses many times). "please fix this for my sanity."

3. "Gramdaddy69" - 130.4 hrs on record - Posted Jul 18, 2025
   Angry that after using the Steam player base to fund the game through early access, the studio released Xbox-exclusive cosmetics. Says it's not about the cosmetics but about loyalty, and won't buy their next game (Cryo).

4. "Onion" - 391.6 hrs on record (389 hrs at review time) - Posted Jan 13, 2025
   "This game was fun until I encountered their moderators via discord. Lying is no okay and also favoritism." Says devs have a long way to go on caring about players and cites many bugs and lags. Does NOT recommend (sarcastic "10/10").

5. "Rohan" - 285.2 hrs on record (211.5 hrs at review time) - Posted May 15, 2024
   Persistent technical issues after full release: holes in the map you can fall through, AI glitches and AI target fixation. Says later story chapters feel less worked on, the last chapter felt like a time loop in map design, and the ending/lore feels half-finished (as if the writer changed or a better idea was scrapped and filler used). Chapters feel stitched together from different ideas.

Common themes across these high-playtime negative reviews: losing cosmetics/progress and harsh cosmetic RNG grind, anger over Xbox-exclusive cosmetics, poor moderation/community handling, and lingering bugs plus a weaker late-game story.
